html:
Greetings, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.!

 

We’ve received a lot of feedback from our forum after our update on 11/29 05:00 (UTC+0) with the release of the Ultimates and the Ultimate Hero Chest.

 

We recognize that our biggest issue was the Ultimate Hero Chest. Different with other heroes, members of the Ultimates could only be acquired from the Ultimate Hero Chest.

 

As a resolution, we released a patch on 11/30 10:21 (UTC+0) – prior to the patch, you could only acquire three (3) of the Ultimates characters (Nova, Blue Marvel, Anti-Man) characters through the Ultimate Hero Chest. After the patch, those characters’ Biometrics could be produced through the S.H.I.E.L.D. Lab’s Processor (Universal Biometrics).

 

In that patch, we should have clarified the wording on the Ultimate Hero Chest screen. We have since changed the wording accordingly. We sincerely apologize for the confusion and we will be distributing a compensation for the inconvenience we may have caused.

 

11/30 (Thursday) 10:21 Patch Compensation Details:

Recipients: Those who purchased Ultimate Hero Chests after 11/29 update ~ before 12/1 13:30 (UTC+0) patch.

Compensation: We will be refunding 50% of the Crystals used to purchase the Ultimate Hero Chest.

 

Once again, we sincerely apologize if we have disappointed you with our recent update. We will try our best to make MARVEL Future Fight a better game.

 

Thank you
